tasks.label: Build ShokaX theme and generate site
args:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Set-Location 'e:\Git_WorkBook\hexo-starter'; $backup = '.	hemes\hexo-theme-shokaX-main-source-backup.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path '.	hemes\hexo-theme-shokaX-main\scripts\*' -DestinationPath $backup -Force; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs
pm.cmd' install 'hexo-renderer-pug@^3.0.0'; Push-Location '.	hemes\hexo-theme-shokaX-main'; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs\corepack.cmd' pnpm@10.13.1 install; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs\corepack.cmd' pnpm@10.13.1 run build; Pop-Location; & '.
ode_modules\.bin\hexo.cmd' clean; & '.
ode_modules\.bin\hexo.cmd' generate; if (-not (Select-String -Path '.\public\index.html' -Pattern '<!DOCTYPE html>' -Quiet)) { throw 'Generated homepage is not HTML.' }; Write-Host 'ShokaX build and Hexo generation completed successfully.'
